title: Test environment installs unpinned requirements
description: tox.ini declares a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==`. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==`.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==`.
limitation: It matches a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==` in the parsed tox.ini; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
